name: ghost-babel
description: Metal Gear Solid: Ghost Babel (Game Boy Color). Analysis profile: three entry points the analyzer does not find on its own.
title: METALGEARGBBMGE
why: Without these addresses gbrecomp still produces a game that runs, but the code
reachable only through these entry points stays outside the analysis. Using
them is what reproduces the validated configuration (hardware tests 75/75,
frame-for-frame comparison against a reference emulator).
This profile contains no game code or data: only the addresses of three entry
points, which is factual information about the ROM.
